questions.subject: en
questions.question: What does “up to 12 million” represent?
questions.answer: The maximum amount mentioned in the pledge
options: The maximum amount mentioned in the pledge
The cash already transferred
The first year’s approved amount
questions.explanation: The pledge is a ceiling, subject to later approvals.
questions.passage: At a meeting, donors pledged up to 12 million units for a program over three years, subject to annual approvals. The first year’s approved amount was 3 million. Only 2 million had been transferred at the date of the report. The program recorded the pledge, approvals, and transfers separately.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: How many municipalities recorded lower losses?
questions.answer: Six
options: Six
Two
Eight
questions.explanation: Six of the eight recorded lower losses.
questions.passage: A program funded flood protection in eight municipalities. Two years later, reported flood losses were lower in six, while rainfall was also milder across the region. The evaluation included project records but lacked a comparison group and consistent baseline data. It concluded that the results were promising but attribution remained uncertain.
